# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Akcent Docs is actively maintained on the latest version available on the `main` branch.

| Version | Supported |
|----------|:---------:|
| Latest | ✅ |

---

## Reporting a Security Issue

If you discover a security vulnerability affecting Akcent Docs or its deployment, please do **not** create a public issue.

Instead, contact the maintainer directly:

- GitHub Issues (for non-sensitive reports)
- Contact page on Akcent Docs
- GitHub profile: https://github.com/AkcentG

Security reports will be reviewed as quickly as possible.

Thank you for helping keep Akcent Docs secure.
